explanation: Fires only at steps t=2..5, never in the copy phase or at t<2. Two contexts: (1) the <DEL> step of short sequences (L=3 fires ~74% of the time; L=4 ~15%), about 39% of mass and holding the strongest activations (top examples are all <DEL> at t=3 with first token n/f/u/h); (2) original-phase inputs z, k or 3 at position 2 or 3 (mostly first occurrence), about 57% of mass. In both contexts it is strongly modulated by the first original token: n, u, j, f, h, i, v, b raise the firing rate (n most of all), so it behaves like a sum of early-token contributions passing a threshold rather than a clean token detector. Rare weak firing on m/l/o at t=2-3. Does not fire on z/k/3 later in the sequence or on <DEL> for L>=5 (with few exceptions). A simple predicate (DEL at L<=4 or z/k/3 at t=2..3) gets about 0.97 mass recall at about 0.32 precision; adding the first-token gate brings dev F1 to about 0.59 and mass recall to about 0.70.
